executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $203.31 per resident day (51.5% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $9,409,470 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 26,926 Medicaid days, $349.46 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $338.84 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $352.30 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 3.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $811,395, 10.7% of the $7,571,696 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,094,550, $29.39 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $491,957 (44.9%), allocated fringe $99,706 (9.1%), non-wage costs $502,887 (45.9%). Raw food was $341,320 ($9.16 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $129,305.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $497,582, $13.36 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $295,818 (59.5%), allocated fringe $59,954 (12.0%), non-wage costs $141,810 (28.5%).
Missing data: cost years 2017, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 10 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $133,497 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Administrative Salaries (page 10 line A4), removed $113,671; Other Physicians (page 13 line B8e), removed $14,531; Other Resident Care Supplies (page 20 line 5m), removed $13,603. Separately, the home itself removed $670,740 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
